| Section | What it covers | Marks |
|---|---|---|

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Answer form.** "How many solutions" → **a whole number**, and **list** every solution in the stated
interval. Angles in **degrees** unless the question is written in $\pi$ (then give exact radians). Lengths,
areas and $\cos\theta$ → **exact** (surd) form. For a "prove" question, work from one side to the other with a
reason at each step. **Beware asymptotes** — a value where $\tan$ is undefined is never a solution.
:::

## Question 7 **[6]**

$0^\circ<\alpha<90^\circ$ (give $\alpha$ to the nearest $0.1^\circ$). **[3]**

&nbsp;&nbsp;(b) Write down the maximum value of $5\cos x-12\sin x$. **[1]**

&nbsp;&nbsp;(c) Hence solve $\;5\cos x-12\sin x=6.5\;$ for $0\le x<360^\circ$ (answers to the nearest
$0.1^\circ$). **[2]**
